description: List saved cohorts for the account (newest first). Returns id, name, member count, and last scan time. Keeps the payload small — use get_cohort for full member detail.
name: list_cohorts

cohorts.description: The cohorts visible to the API key making the call. Empty when the org has none; the MCP layer wraps the upstream array so the result is always an object.

items.description: A saved cohort: a named set of borrower records the org can re-scan for savings.

count.description: Number of items in the array above. There is no pagination on this route — this is the complete set for the org, not a page.
